title: Untitled (Paris with red stars, trucks and rivers)

said.q: This drawing is part of a series of drawings made between 1997 through 2000. Amongst the series of travel, this drawing portrays the Garden and Seine River flowing through the City of Light, Paris.
said.by: Thomas Solomon Art Advisory, on Artsy
